# University of Chicago — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where is University of Chicago?", "USA"),
    ("What is notable about University of Chicago?", "92 Nobel affiliates"),
    ("What is location?", "USA"),
    ("What is key stat?", "1890"),
    ("What is notable fact?", "92 Nobel affiliates"),
    ("What is note?", "Economics powerhouse"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
